packs.title: Art, Nature and Red Rocks
packs.promise: Explore Denver through landmark buildings, museum discoveries and a landscape built for music.

q.s: Carry away one story from a guide rather than a souvenir.
st: Book an available tour and follow its visitor route.
Choose one fact shared by the guide that interests you.
Record it in your own words and add a question for later.

q.s: Let a short change in viewpoint reveal a different relationship between city and water.
st: Choose an open path near the park’s public approach.
Move a comfortable short distance, stopping clear of other path users.
Compare the water and building shapes from two positions, then return if you wish.

q.s: Use an artwork’s visual relationship to begin something original.
st: Choose an artwork and credit its maker and title.
Notice how two shapes or colors relate.
Make an original composition or written scene with a different subject, following gallery rules or working afterward.

packs.title: LoDo and Small Discoveries
packs.promise: Find architectural rhythms, neighborhood stories and small creative prompts around Lower Downtown.

q.s: Look closely at a hotel’s public face.
st: Use the public sidewalk and leave arrivals clear.
Find three contrasting exterior materials or textures.
Describe one detail that makes the entrance feel distinct.

q.s: Make an original record of color relationships in a small space.
st: Enter only the currently open pedestrian area.
Choose three visible colors from architecture or decor, crediting any artwork used as inspiration.
Draw an original abstract arrangement of those colors without copying a mural.

q.s: Learn a place’s story from the people who steward it.
st: Use the square’s official About page or available interpretation.
Record one named community figure and one stated contribution in your own words.
Keep the source with your note and add a question you want to explore.
